summary: Configured Lighttpd on node1 to serve public/ at TCP 8080 and execute the supplied report at /cgi-bin/report. Private/application files remain outside the document root. Configuration and report output persisted across the mandatory node restart.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible Lighttpd packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured public/ as the document root and mapped the external cgi-bin/ directory for CGI execution.
Enabled Lighttpd in the default OpenRC runlevel.
Verified static content, CGI output, isolation of private files, and restart persistence.

evidence.requirement: Static content and executable report endpoint
evidence.summary: GET / returns the warehouse index; GET /cgi-bin/report returns HTTP 200, text/plain, and the preserved output warehouse=west and open_orders=7.

evidence.requirement: Application source and private content remain outside published content
evidence.summary: Document root is public/; private and handover paths return 404, CGI directory listing returns 403, and public/ contains only index.html with no symlinks.
Lighttpd is supervised by OpenRC, enabled at boot, and listens on 0.0.0.0:8080. Alpine 3.23 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain installed after restart.

Healthy baseline captured with boot ID deac7fa1-325c-4b4c-be48-f44a7607de1e; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed to d219b099-fa11-4149-988e-4e830d023bf4; service, listener, static content, report output, exclusions, and unchanged asset hashes were verified after recovery.
